steps.label: entpacken
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && [ "$(md5 -q bk2.tgz)" = 2bb17df25a6355c4ca739ff42b75d024 ] && rm -rf bk2 && mkdir bk2 && tar xzf bk2.tgz -C bk2 && for f in bk2/bundle/*.js; do [ -f "$f.map" ] || echo '{"version":3,"sources":[],"names":[],"mappings":""}' > "$f.map"; done; ls bk2/bundle/public | wc -l

steps.label: musik
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && I=""; for n in $(cat bk2/tracks.txt); do f=$(find "$HOME/ShortsRenderAgent/music/lib" -name "$n.mp3" | head -1); [ -n "$f" ] || { echo "MISSING $n"; exit 1; }; I="$I -i $f"; done; npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i bk2/mixv.m4a $I -filter_complex_script bk2/fg.txt -map "[out]" -c:a aac -b:a 224k bk2/mixm.m4a && ls -l bk2/mixm.m4a

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render bk2/bundle P bk2_out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i bk2_out.mp4 -i bk2/mixm.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest bk2_film.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i bk2_film.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -crf 27 -c:a aac -b:a 128k bk2_720.mp4 && (npx remotion ffmpeg -hide_banner -i bk2_film.mp4 -af ebur128 -f null - 2>&1 | tail -12 > bk2_loud.txt || true); ls -l bk2_film.mp4 bk2_720.mp4 > bk2_done.txt; cat bk2_done.txt
